description: This file defines a PHP interface within the AWS SDK, specifically for abstracting the container of an HTTP response. It declares a method to retrieve a response object conforming to PSR-7 standards.

classes.name: ResponseContainerInterface
classes.description: An interface defining a contract for classes to provide an HTTP response, if any, within the AWS PHP SDK.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP response object if available, returning null otherwise.
